steps.message: You are a helpful assistant that can interact with a computer.

Please solve this issue: We're building backend for a helpdesk SaaS for businesses and their customers.
Use Rails in API-only mode; the frontend is a separate app.
Ruby, Rails, Puma, and PostgreSQL are installed. If you need anything else, install it yourself.
Use `DATABASE_URL`. Work in `/app`.

The team now has departments such as Billing and Technical Support. Let admins create, rename,
and delete groups, and add staff to more than one group. Staff can browse groups and memberships;
groups organize work, they don't hide tickets from other staff.

For example:

```http
POST /api/v1/groups

{"group":{"name":"Billing"}}
```

```http
POST /api/v1/group_memberships

{"group_membership":{"group_id":20,"user_id":12,"default":true}}
```

Use the usual list, detail, and delete routes for both resources, plus PATCH for group names.
List groups and memberships by ID ascending.
Let admins choose a staff member's default with `PUT /group_memberships/:id/make_default`.
Every staff member with memberships should have one default;
removing it should pick another remaining membership.
Filter memberships by `group_id` and `user_id`.

Tickets can now have a `group_id`, with the group's ID/name in `group`, and staff can filter the
inbox by group or `group_id=unassigned`.

An assigned person must belong to the ticket's group. Assigning someone to an ungrouped ticket
should use their default group, if they have one. Moving a ticket to another group should clear
an assignee who doesn't belong there. Clearing the assignee leaves the group in place; explicitly
clearing the group also clears the assignee. Deleting groups or memberships clears invalid assignments.
Suspension keeps memberships for later.

    class BaseController < ApplicationController
      include ApiV1Serializers
      include ApiV1Pagination

      rescue_from ActionController::ParameterMissing do |e|
        render_error(e.message, status: :bad_request)
      end

      rescue_from ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound, ActiveModel::RangeError do
        render_error("Not found", status: :not_found)
      end

        render_model_errors(e.record)
      end

      before_action :require_account!

      private

      attr_reader :current_account, :current_session, :current_user

      def require_account!
        subdomain = request.headers["X-Helpdesk-Account"].to_s.strip.downcase
        if subdomain.blank?
          return render_error("X-Helpdesk-Account header is required", status: :bad_request)
        end

        @current_account = Account.find_by(subdomain: subdomain)
        unless @current_account
          render_error("Account not found", status: :not_found)
        end
      end

      def require_authentication!
        token = extract_bearer_token
        @current_session = Session.authenticate(account: current_account, raw_token: token)
        unless @current_session
          return render_error("Authentication required", status: :unauthorized)
        end

        @current_user = @current_session.user
      end

      def require_active_account!
        if current_account.cancelled?
          render_error("Account is cancelled", status: :forbidden)
        end
      end

      def require_owner!
        unless current_user&.owner?
          render_error("Only the account owner can perform this action", status: :forbidden)
        end
      end

      def require_admin!
        unless current_user&.admin?
          render_error("Admin access required", status: :forbidden)
        end
      end

      def require_staff!
        unless current_user&.staff?
          render_error("Staff access required", status: :forbidden)
        end
      end

      def require_hash_param(key, source = params)
        value = source.require(key)
        unless value.is_a?(ActionController::Parameters)
          raise ActionController::ParameterMissing.new(key)
        end

        value
      end

      def optional_hash_param(key, source = params)
        return nil unless source.key?(key)

        value = source[key]
        return nil if value.nil?

        unless value.is_a?(ActionController::Parameters)
          raise ActionController::ParameterMissing.new(key)
        end

        value
      end

      def parse_id_param(key = :id)
        raw = params[key]
        value = Integer(raw.to_s, 10)
        raise ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound unless value.positive?

        value
      rescue ArgumentError, TypeError
        raise ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound
      end

      def extract_bearer_token
        header = request.headers["Authorization"].to_s
        scheme, token = header.split(/\s+/, 2)
        return nil unless scheme&.casecmp?("Bearer") && token.present?

        token.strip
      end

      def render_error(message, status:, errors: nil)
        payload = { error: message }
        payload[:errors] = errors if errors.present?
        render json: payload, status: status
      end

      def render_model_errors(record)
        errors_hash = record.errors.to_hash(true)
        message = record.errors.full_messages.first || "Validation failed"
        render_error(message, status: :unprocessable_content, errors: errors_hash)
      end

      def render_validation_errors(errors_hash)
        message = errors_hash.values.flatten.first || "Validation failed"
        render_error(message, status: :unprocessable_content, errors: errors_hash)
      end
    end
  end

    page = parse_positive_integer(params[:page], default: DEFAULT_PAGE)
    per_page = parse_positive_integer(params[:per_page], default: DEFAULT_PER_PAGE)
    per_page = MAX_PER_PAGE if per_page > MAX_PER_PAGE

    return default if raw.blank?

    name: nil,
    role_provided: false,

    suspended_provided: false,
    suspended: nil

    @name = name
    @role_provided = role_provided
    @role = role
    @suspended_provided = suspended_provided
    @suspended = suspended

      @user.lock!

  end

  private

  def validate_and_apply_changes
    case @mode
    when :staff
      validate_and_apply_staff_changes
    when :customer
      validate_and_apply_customer_changes
    else
      raise ArgumentError, "Unknown update mode: #{@mode.inspect}"
    end
  end

  def validate_and_apply_staff_changes
    errors = {}

    unless @comment_provided || @status_provided || @priority_provided || @assignee_id_provided
      return { base: [ "Provide a comment, status, priority, or assignee_id to update" ] }

    if @solved_provided && @solved != true && @solved != false

    mark_solved_via_flag = @solved_provided && @solved == true

class TicketFilter
  MAX_BIGINT = (1 << 63) - 1
  POSITIVE_INTEGER_FORMAT = /\A[1-9]\d*\z/

  Result = Struct.new(:success?, :scope, :errors, keyword_init: true)

  def initialize(scope:, params:, mode:)
    @scope = scope
    @params = params
    @mode = mode
  end

  def call
    scope = @scope
    errors = {}

    case @mode
    when :staff
      scope = apply_status(scope, errors)
      scope = apply_priority(scope, errors)
      scope = apply_assignee(scope, errors)
      scope = apply_requester(scope, errors)
      scope = apply_search(scope, errors)
    when :customer
      scope = apply_status(scope, errors)
    else
      raise ArgumentError, "Unknown filter mode: #{@mode.inspect}"
    end

    if errors.any?
      Result.new(success?: false, scope: @scope.none, errors: errors)
    else
      Result.new(success?: true, scope: scope, errors: {})
    end
  end

  private

  def apply_status(scope, errors)
    raw = @params[:status]
    return scope unless raw.present?

    status = raw.is_a?(String) ? raw.strip.downcase : nil
    if Ticket::STATUSES.include?(status)
      scope.with_status(status)
    else
      errors["status"] = [ "Status must be one of: #{Ticket::STATUSES.join(', ')}" ]
      scope
    end
  end

  def apply_priority(scope, errors)
    raw = @params[:priority]
    return scope unless raw.present?

    priority = raw.is_a?(String) ? raw.strip.downcase : nil
    if Ticket::PRIORITIES.include?(priority)
      scope.with_priority(priority)
    else
      errors["priority"] = [ "Priority must be one of: #{Ticket::PRIORITIES.join(', ')}" ]
      scope
    end
  end

  def apply_assignee(scope, errors)
    raw = @params[:assignee_id]
    return scope unless raw.present?

    value = raw.is_a?(String) ? raw.strip.downcase : nil
    if value == "unassigned"
      scope.unassigned
    elsif (id = parse_positive_bigint(value))
      scope.assigned_to(id)
    else
      errors["assignee_id"] = [ "Assignee must be a valid user ID or unassigned" ]
      scope
    end
  end

  def apply_requester(scope, errors)
    raw = @params[:requester_id]
    return scope unless raw.present?

    value = raw.is_a?(String) ? raw.strip : nil
    if (id = parse_positive_bigint(value))
      scope.requested_by(id)
    else
      errors["requester_id"] = [ "Requester must be a valid user ID" ]
      scope
    end
  end

  def apply_search(scope, errors)
    raw = @params[:q]
    return scope unless raw.present?

    unless raw.is_a?(String)
      errors["q"] = [ "Query must be a string" ]
      return scope
    end

    query = raw.strip
    return scope if query.blank?

    scope.search_text(query)
  end

  def parse_positive_bigint(value)
    return nil unless value.is_a?(String) && POSITIVE_INTEGER_FORMAT.match?(value)

    parsed = Integer(value, 10)
    parsed <= MAX_BIGINT ? parsed : nil
  rescue ArgumentError
    nil
  end
end

  module V1
    class SessionsController < BaseController
      before_action :require_authentication!, only: :destroy

      def create
        session_params = require_hash_param(:session).permit(:email, :password)
        email = session_params[:email].to_s.strip.downcase
        password = session_params[:password]

        if email.blank? || !password.is_a?(String) || password.blank?
          return render_error("Invalid email or password", status: :unauthorized)
        end

        user = current_account.users.authenticate_by(email: email, password: password)
        unless user
          return render_error("Invalid email or password", status: :unauthorized)
        end

        if user.suspended?
          return render_error("User account is suspended", status: :forbidden)
        end

        unless user.verified?
          return render_error("Email address must be verified before signing in", status: :forbidden)
        end

        if current_account.cancelled?
          if current_account.reactivation_expired?
            return render_error("Account cancellation period has expired", status: :forbidden)
          end

          unless user.owner?
            return render_error("Account is cancelled", status: :forbidden)
          end
        end

        session, raw_token = Session.issue_for(user)
        render json: {
          session: serialize_session(session, raw_token),
          user: serialize_user(user),
          account: serialize_account(current_account)
        }, status: :created
      end

      def destroy
        current_session.revoke!
        head :no_content
      end
    end
  end
end

**Deep Dive into Ticket Assignment Logic**

Okay, after carefully re-reading the prompt, especially that crucial section on ticket assignment, my understanding is solidifying. I'm focusing on the interplay between group memberships and ticket assignments. I'm finding it is best to carefully and systematically trace every single case for every phrase in the prompt, plus examine the existing tests to build a strong foundation.

First, I re-read the prompt meticulously, line by line. I focused particularly on the phrase, "An assigned person must belong to the ticket's group." and the very nuanced part "Assigning someone to an ungrouped ticket should use their default group, *if they have one*." The crucial bit here is the emphasis on "if they have one." That suggests it's possible for an assignment to happen even without a default group, which existing tests confirm. This means that if someone is assigned to a ticket with *no* group, and they have no memberships (so *no* default group), it's perfectly valid, and the ticket simply remains ungrouped, with the assignee set.

Second, I parsed the prompt's phrase-by-phrase, and tried a case-by-case analysis.

Third, I looked to the existing tests to provide key clues to validate this understanding. I carefully analyzed how the tests deal with scenarios where no groups exist initially, and the assignment flow. I'm taking notes. The tests seem to allow assigning users *without* default groups to tickets without complaint. That reinforces my hypothesis: not every user *needs* a default group to be assigned.

Fourth, I carefully noted the cases for explicit clearing of a ticket's group. With that, clearing a group also clears the assignee. I'm taking notes here too.

Fifth, I analyzed "Deleting groups or memberships clears invalid assignments." I needed to trace TWO parts:
 *   When a group is deleted, *all* tickets assigned to that group become unassigned, and the ticket's `group_id` is set to null, and `assignee_id` is cleared. This is because the group no longer exists.
 *   When a membership is deleted, *only* on the tickets that are *both* assigned to the specific user AND to the specific group is where the assignee is cleared. This makes sense: the user can no longer be assigned to the specific group, since they are no longer in that group! The `group_id` remains in place, but the `assignee_id` is removed.

Sixth, I'm now going to explore the rest of the codebase to gain a comprehensive understanding before fully finalizing the implementation details.

class InboundEmailProcessor
  Result = Struct.new(:status, :ticket, :comment, keyword_init: true) do
    def accepted?
      status == :accepted
    end

    def duplicate?
      status == :duplicate
    end

    def rejected?
      status == :rejected
    end
  end

  def initialize(inbound_email:)
    @inbound_email = inbound_email
  end

  def call
    mail = parse_mail
    return rejected unless mail

    extractor = InboundEmailContentExtractor.new(mail: mail)
    sender = extractor.sender

    return rejected if InboundEmailFilter.new(mail: mail, from_email: sender&.email).ignore?

    resolution = InboundEmailRecipientResolver.new(mail: mail).call
    return rejected unless resolution.valid?
    return rejected unless sender

    if resolution.reply?
      requester = resolution.ticket.requester
      return rejected if requester.nil? || requester.suspended? || requester.email != sender.email
    end

    body = extractor.plain_text_body
    return rejected if body.blank?

    message_id = InboundEmailMessageId.extract(mail, fallback: @inbound_email.message_id)
    return rejected if message_id.blank?

    return duplicate if TicketComment.exists?(email_message_id: message_id)

        account: resolution.account,
        ticket: resolution.ticket,
        sender: sender,
        body: body,
        message_id: message_id
      )
    else
      create_new_ticket(
        account: resolution.account,
        sender: sender,
        subject: extractor.subject,
        body: body,
        message_id: message_id
      )
    end
  end

    created_user = nil

First, `group.rb`. I'm going to set up the necessary associations. I need it to `belongs_to :account`, obviously. Then, a `has_many :group_memberships`, with `dependent: :destroy` and `inverse_of: :group`. That makes sense. It also `has_many :users, through: :group_memberships`, and `has_many :tickets, dependent: :nullify` (we don't want to completely lose the tickets if a group is deleted), and I'll include `inverse_of: :group`. I'll use `normalizes :name` to handle whitespace, and standard validations for name presence, length, and uniqueness scoped to the account, case-insensitive. Finally, I'll add the `by_id_asc` scope for easier querying.

Moving on to `group_membership.rb`, I need to establish the relationships here. It will `belongs_to :account`, `belongs_to :group`, using `inverse_of: :group_memberships`, and `belongs_to :user`, using `inverse_of: :group_memberships`. The validations here are crucial. I'll need to validate `default` is a boolean. I also want a unique constraint for `user_id` and `group_id` combination. I'm going to add two custom validations for `group_belongs_to_account` and `user_must_be_staff_in_account` to ensure data integrity. Then, some scopes: `by_id_asc`, `default_only`, `for_group`, and `for_user`. Those will be useful.

Now, updating `account.rb`. I'm going to add `has_many :group_memberships, dependent: :destroy` and `has_many :groups, dependent: :destroy`. I'll place these right after the existing `has_many :tickets, dependent: :destroy` association.

For `user.rb`, I need to add `has_many :group_memberships, dependent: :destroy, inverse_of: :user` and `has_many :groups, through: :group_memberships`. Then, for convenience, I'll add two helper methods: `default_group_membership` and `default_group` to simplify retrieving the default group and its associated membership.

Finally, `ticket.rb`. I need to add a `belongs_to :group, optional: true, inverse_of: :tickets`. I'll also add validations to ensure `group_belongs_to_account` when a group is present and to ensure the assignee actually belongs to the group using `assignee_must_belong_to_group`, when both are present. Also adding scopes for `ungrouped` tickets and those that `in_group`.

  belongs_to :group, inverse_of: :group_memberships

  end

  normalizes :subdomain, with: ->(subdomain) { subdomain.to_s.strip.downcase }

  validates :name, presence: true, length: { maximum: 255 }
  validates :subdomain,
            presence: true,
            uniqueness: { case_sensitive: false },
            format: {
              with: SUBDOMAIN_FORMAT,
              message: "must use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens without leading or trailing hyphens"
            }

  scope :active, -> { where(cancelled_at: nil) }
  scope :cancelled, -> { where.not(cancelled_at: nil) }
  scope :purgeable, -> { cancelled.where("cancelled_at <= ?", REACTIVATION_WINDOW.ago) }

  before_destroy :clear_owner_reference

  def self.purge_cancelled!
    purged_count = 0
    purgeable.find_each do |account|
      account.destroy!
      purged_count += 1
    end
    purged_count
  end

  def cancelled?
    cancelled_at.present?
  end

  def active?
    !cancelled?
  end

  def status
    cancelled? ? "cancelled" : "active"
  end

  def purge_at
    cancelled_at&.+ REACTIVATION_WINDOW
  end

  def reactivation_expired?
    cancelled? && cancelled_at <= REACTIVATION_WINDOW.ago
  end

  def reactivatable?
    cancelled? && !reactivation_expired?
  end

  def cancel!
    transaction do
      now = Time.current
      update!(cancelled_at: now)
      sessions.active.update_all(revoked_at: now, updated_at: now)
    end
  end

  def reactivate!
    update!(cancelled_at: nil)
  end

  private

    update_column(:owner_id, nil) if owner_id.present?
  end

require "securerandom"

class Ticket < ApplicationRecord
  STATUSES = %w[open pending solved].freeze
  PRIORITIES = %w[normal high].freeze
  ORIGINS = %w[portal email].freeze

  belongs_to :account
  belongs_to :requester, class_name: "User", inverse_of: :requested_tickets
  belongs_to :group, optional: true, inverse_of: :tickets
  belongs_to :assignee, class_name: "User", optional: true, inverse_of: :assigned_tickets
  has_many :comments, class_name: "TicketComment", dependent: :destroy, inverse_of: :ticket

  normalizes :subject, with: ->(subject) { subject.to_s.strip }

  before_validation :ensure_reply_token, on: :create

  validates :subject, presence: true, length: { maximum: 255 }
  validates :status, presence: true, inclusion: { in: STATUSES }
  validates :priority, presence: true, inclusion: { in: PRIORITIES }
  validates :origin, presence: true, inclusion: { in: ORIGINS }
  validates :reply_token, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  validate :requester_belongs_to_account
  validate :group_belongs_to_account, if: -> { group_id.present? || group.present? }
  validate :assignee_must_be_active_staff_in_account, if: -> { assignee_id.present? && (new_record? || will_save_change_to_assignee_id?) }
  validate :assignee_must_belong_to_group, if: -> { group_id.present? && assignee_id.present? }

  before_create :set_initial_public_updated_at
  before_update :update_public_updated_at_if_customer_visible

  scope :recently_active, -> { order(updated_at: :desc, id: :desc) }
  scope :public_recently_active, -> { order(public_updated_at: :desc, id: :desc) }
  scope :for_requester, ->(user) { where(requester_id: user.id) }
  scope :with_status, ->(status) { where(status: status) }
  scope :with_priority, ->(priority) { where(priority: priority) }
  scope :ungrouped, -> { where(group_id: nil) }
  scope :in_group, ->(group_id) { where(group_id: group_id) }
  scope :unassigned, -> { where(assignee_id: nil) }
  scope :assigned_to, ->(user_id) { where(assignee_id: user_id) }
  scope :requested_by, ->(user_id) { where(requester_id: user_id) }
  scope :search_text, ->(query) {
    return none if !query.is_a?(String) || query.include?("\x00") || !query.valid_encoding?

    pattern = "%#{sanitize_sql_like(query)}%"
    where(
      <<~SQL.squish,
        tickets.subject ILIKE :pattern ESCAPE '\\'
        OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM ticket_comments
          WHERE ticket_comments.ticket_id = tickets.id
            AND ticket_comments.account_id = tickets.account_id
            AND ticket_comments.public = TRUE
            AND ticket_comments.body ILIKE :pattern ESCAPE '\\'
        )
      SQL
      pattern: pattern
    )
  }

  def open?
    status == "open"
  end

  def pending?
    status == "pending"
  end

  def solved?
    status == "solved"
  end

  def normal_priority?
    priority == "normal"
  end

  def high_priority?
    priority == "high"
  end

  def email_origin?
    origin == "email"
  end

  def reply_address
    HelpdeskConfig.ticket_reply_address(self)
  end

  private

  def ensure_reply_token
    self.reply_token ||= SecureRandom.hex(16)
  end

  def set_initial_public_updated_at
    now = updated_at || created_at || Time.current
    self.created_at ||= now
    self.updated_at ||= now
    self.public_updated_at ||= now
  end

  def update_public_updated_at_if_customer_visible
    if will_save_change_to_status? || will_save_change_to_subject?
      now = Time.current
      self.updated_at = now
      self.public_updated_at = now
    end
  end

  def requester_belongs_to_account
    return unless account_id.present? && requester.present?
    return if requester.account_id == account_id

    errors.add(:requester, "must belong to the same account")
  end

  def group_belongs_to_account
    return unless account_id.present?

    if group.nil? || group.account_id != account_id
      errors.add(:group_id, "must belong to the same account")
    end
  end

  def assignee_must_be_active_staff_in_account
    return unless account_id.present?

    if assignee.nil?
      errors.add(:assignee_id, "must be an active staff member in this account")
    elsif assignee.account_id != account_id
      errors.add(:assignee_id, "must belong to the same account")
    elsif !assignee.staff?
      errors.add(:assignee_id, "must be a staff member")
    elsif assignee.suspended?
      errors.add(:assignee_id, "must be an active staff member")
    end
  end

  def assignee_must_belong_to_group
    return unless account_id.present? && group.present? && assignee.present?
    return unless group.account_id == account_id && assignee.account_id == account_id
    return if GroupMembership.exists?(account_id: account_id, group_id: group_id, user_id: assignee_id)

    errors.add(:assignee_id, "must belong to the ticket's group")
  end
end
EOF

steps.reasoning_content:
**Service Implementation Refinement**

Okay, so I'm moving into implementing these new services: `GroupDeletion`, `GroupMembershipCreation`, `GroupMembershipMakeDefault`, and `GroupMembershipDeletion`. I'll also need to update `TicketFilter`, `TicketUpdater`, and `UserUpdater`. Before diving into `TicketUpdater`, I need to really solidify the edge cases and potential rollback scenarios.

First, let's consider a scenario where I'm updating a ticket. Say it currently has `group_id: G1` and `assignee_id: U1` (where U1 is a member of G1). Now, I get a request to change the ticket's group to G2 *and* add a comment, but U1 isn't in G2. The initial `validate_and_apply_staff_changes` method will update the ticket's group, and set the assignee to nil, then the empty comment body will trigger a validation error and a rollback, leaving the database untouched.

Now, imagine an ungrouped ticket, and someone tries to assign the ticket. Say the ticket is ungrouped, and the request tries to assign the ticket to U2, and set the ticket status to 'bad_status'. This will set the ticket status, group and assignee as they are required, but since the status is bad, there will be validation errors and a rollback.

Finally, consider another scenario to update a ticket. If a user tries to change the group ID to nil, and add an empty comment, the validation error on the comment body will cause a rollback. The database will remain unchanged.

Next, I need to check scenarios with invalid group/assignee lookups. If I have a ticket in `G1` and assigned to `U1`, and the request includes an invalid `group_id` but valid `assignee_id`, the lookup will fail. The `group_id` will trigger validation errors, causing the request to fail.

What happens if both `group_id` and `assignee_id` are invalid? The code will correctly return both errors, resulting in a 422.

Now, let's look at `GroupMembershipCreation`. I have to be careful about validation order. Suppose I try to create a membership with a valid group and user, but an invalid 'default' value (e.g., "yes" instead of a boolean). If the `default` validation fails first, it should return a 422 before even checking for duplicates. What if the request has missing `group_id` and `user_id`? It must return both errors and a 422. If the request is empty (`{"group_membership": {}}`), it should raise `ActionController::ParameterMissing` resulting in a 400. This is the expected behavior, like empty ticket or user requests.

Now that I've carefully considered these scenarios, I can start writing these services.

class GroupDeletion
  def initialize(account:, group:)
    @account = account
    @group = group
  end

  def call
    ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
      @account.lock!
      group = @account.groups.lock.find(@group.id)
      now = Time.current

      affected_default_user_ids = group.group_memberships.where(default: true).pluck(:user_id)

      @account.tickets
              .where(group_id: group.id)
              .update_all(group_id: nil, assignee_id: nil, updated_at: now)

      group.destroy!

      affected_default_user_ids.each do |user_id|
        replacement = @account.group_memberships.where(user_id: user_id).by_id_asc.first
        replacement&.update!(default: true)
      end
    end
  end
end
EOF

cat <<'EOF' > /app/app/services/group_membership_creation.rb
class GroupMembershipCreation
  MAX_BIGINT = (1 << 63) - 1
  Result = Struct.new(:success?, :group_membership, :errors, keyword_init: true)

  def initialize(account:, group_id:, user_id:, default_provided: false, default: nil)
    @account = account
    @group_id = group_id
    @user_id = user_id
    @default_provided = default_provided
    @default = default
  end

  def call
    errors = {}
    membership = nil

    ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
      @account.lock!
      now = Time.current

      group = resolve_group(errors)
      user = resolve_user(errors)

      if @default_provided && @default != true && @default != false
        (errors["default"] ||= []) << "Default must be true or false"
      end

      if errors.any?
        raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
      end

      user.lock!

      if @account.group_memberships.exists?(group_id: group.id, user_id: user.id)
        errors["user_id"] = [ "User is already a member of this group" ]
        raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
      end

      has_existing_memberships = user.group_memberships.exists?
      make_default = !has_existing_memberships || (@default_provided && @default == true)

      if make_default && has_existing_memberships
        user.group_memberships.where(default: true).update_all(default: false, updated_at: now)
      end

      membership = @account.group_memberships.new(
        group: group,
        user: user,
        default: make_default
      )

      unless membership.valid?
        membership.errors.each do |error|
          (errors[error.attribute.to_s] ||= []) << error.full_message
        end
        raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
      end

      membership.save!
    end

    if errors.any?
      Result.new(success?: false, group_membership: nil, errors: errors)
    else
      reloaded = @account.group_memberships.includes(:group, :user).find(membership.id)
      Result.new(success?: true, group_membership: reloaded, errors: {})
    end
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique
    Result.new(
      success?: false,
      group_membership: nil,
      errors: { "user_id" => [ "User is already a member of this group" ] }
    )
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => e
    Result.new(success?: false, group_membership: nil, errors: e.record.errors.to_hash(true))
  end

  private

  def resolve_group(errors)
    parsed_id = parse_positive_bigint(@group_id)
    if parsed_id.nil?
      (errors["group_id"] ||= []) << "Group must be a valid group in this account"
      return nil
    end

    group = @account.groups.find_by(id: parsed_id)
    unless group
      (errors["group_id"] ||= []) << "Group must be a valid group in this account"
      return nil
    end

    group
  end

  def resolve_user(errors)
    parsed_id = parse_positive_bigint(@user_id)
    if parsed_id.nil?
      (errors["user_id"] ||= []) << "User must be a staff member in this account"
      return nil
    end

    user = @account.users.find_by(id: parsed_id)
    if user.nil?
      (errors["user_id"] ||= []) << "User must be a staff member in this account"
      return nil
    elsif !user.staff?
      (errors["user_id"] ||= []) << "User must be a staff member"
      return nil
    end

    user
  end

  def parse_positive_bigint(raw)
    value = case raw
            when Integer
              raw
            when String
              return nil unless /\A[1-9]\d*\z/.match?(raw)
              Integer(raw, 10)
            else
              return nil
            end
    return nil unless value.positive? && value <= MAX_BIGINT

    value
  end
end
EOF

cat <<'EOF' > /app/app/services/group_membership_make_default.rb
class GroupMembershipMakeDefault
  def initialize(account:, membership:)
    @account = account
    @membership = membership
  end

  def call
    updated = nil

    ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
      @account.lock!
      membership = @account.group_memberships.lock.find(@membership.id)
      user = membership.user.lock!

      unless membership.default?
        now = Time.current
        user.group_memberships.where(default: true).where.not(id: membership.id)
            .update_all(default: false, updated_at: now)
        membership.update!(default: true)
      end

      updated = membership
    end

    @account.group_memberships.includes(:group, :user).find(updated.id)
  end
end
EOF

class GroupMembershipDeletion
  def initialize(account:, membership:)
    @account = account
    @membership = membership
  end

  def call
    ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
      @account.lock!
      membership = @account.group_memberships.lock.find(@membership.id)
      user = membership.user.lock!
      now = Time.current

      group_id = membership.group_id
      user_id = membership.user_id
      was_default = membership.default?

      membership.destroy!

      @account.tickets
              .where(group_id: group_id, assignee_id: user_id)
              .update_all(assignee_id: nil, updated_at: now)

      if was_default || !user.group_memberships.where(default: true).exists?
        replacement = user.group_memberships.by_id_asc.first
        replacement&.update!(default: true)
      end
    end
  end

class TicketFilter
  MAX_BIGINT = (1 << 63) - 1
  POSITIVE_INTEGER_FORMAT = /\A[1-9]\d*\z/

  Result = Struct.new(:success?, :scope, :errors, keyword_init: true)

  def initialize(scope:, params:, mode:)
    @scope = scope
    @params = params
    @mode = mode
  end

  def call
    scope = @scope
    errors = {}

    case @mode
    when :staff
      scope = apply_status(scope, errors)
      scope = apply_priority(scope, errors)
      scope = apply_group(scope, errors)
      scope = apply_assignee(scope, errors)
      scope = apply_requester(scope, errors)
      scope = apply_search(scope, errors)
    when :customer
      scope = apply_status(scope, errors)
    else
      raise ArgumentError, "Unknown filter mode: #{@mode.inspect}"
    end

    if errors.any?
      Result.new(success?: false, scope: @scope.none, errors: errors)
    else
      Result.new(success?: true, scope: scope, errors: {})
    end
  end

  private

  def apply_status(scope, errors)
    raw = @params[:status]
    return scope unless raw.present?

    status = raw.is_a?(String) ? raw.strip.downcase : nil
    if Ticket::STATUSES.include?(status)
      scope.with_status(status)
    else
      errors["status"] = [ "Status must be one of: #{Ticket::STATUSES.join(', ')}" ]
      scope
    end
  end

  def apply_priority(scope, errors)
    raw = @params[:priority]
    return scope unless raw.present?

    priority = raw.is_a?(String) ? raw.strip.downcase : nil
    if Ticket::PRIORITIES.include?(priority)
      scope.with_priority(priority)
    else
      errors["priority"] = [ "Priority must be one of: #{Ticket::PRIORITIES.join(', ')}" ]
      scope
    end
  end

  def apply_group(scope, errors)
    raw = @params[:group_id]
    return scope unless raw.present?

    value = raw.is_a?(String) ? raw.strip.downcase : nil
    if value == "unassigned"
      scope.ungrouped
    elsif (id = parse_positive_bigint(value))
      scope.in_group(id)
    else
      errors["group_id"] = [ "Group must be a valid group ID or unassigned" ]
      scope
    end
  end

  def apply_assignee(scope, errors)
    raw = @params[:assignee_id]
    return scope unless raw.present?

    value = raw.is_a?(String) ? raw.strip.downcase : nil
    if value == "unassigned"
      scope.unassigned
    elsif (id = parse_positive_bigint(value))
      scope.assigned_to(id)
    else
      errors["assignee_id"] = [ "Assignee must be a valid user ID or unassigned" ]
      scope
    end
  end

  def apply_requester(scope, errors)
    raw = @params[:requester_id]
    return scope unless raw.present?

    value = raw.is_a?(String) ? raw.strip : nil
    if (id = parse_positive_bigint(value))
      scope.requested_by(id)
    else
      errors["requester_id"] = [ "Requester must be a valid user ID" ]
      scope
    end
  end

  def apply_search(scope, errors)
    raw = @params[:q]
    return scope unless raw.present?

    unless raw.is_a?(String)
      errors["q"] = [ "Query must be a string" ]
      return scope
    end

    query = raw.strip
    return scope if query.blank?

    scope.search_text(query)
  end

  def parse_positive_bigint(value)
    return nil unless value.is_a?(String) && POSITIVE_INTEGER_FORMAT.match?(value)

    parsed = Integer(value, 10)
    parsed <= MAX_BIGINT ? parsed : nil
  rescue ArgumentError
    nil
  end
end
EOF

class TicketUpdater
  MAX_BIGINT = (1 << 63) - 1
  Result = Struct.new(:success?, :ticket, :comment, :errors, keyword_init: true)

  def initialize(
    ticket:,
    actor:,
    mode:,
    comment_provided: false,
    comment_body: nil,
    comment_public: true,
    status_provided: false,
    status: nil,
    priority_provided: false,
    priority: nil,
    group_id_provided: false,
    group_id: nil,
    assignee_id_provided: false,
    assignee_id: nil,
    solved_provided: false,
    solved: nil
  )
    @ticket = ticket
    @actor = actor
    @mode = mode
    @comment_provided = comment_provided
    @comment_body = comment_body
    @comment_public = comment_public
    @status_provided = status_provided
    @status = status
    @priority_provided = priority_provided
    @priority = priority
    @group_id_provided = group_id_provided
    @group_id = group_id
    @assignee_id_provided = assignee_id_provided
    @assignee_id = assignee_id
    @solved_provided = solved_provided
    @solved = solved
  end

  def call
    errors = {}
    saved_comment = nil

    ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
      @ticket.lock!
      @pending_comment = nil

      errors = validate_and_apply_changes
      if errors.any?
        raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
      end

      @ticket.save! if @ticket.changed?
      if @pending_comment
        @pending_comment.save!
        saved_comment = @pending_comment
      end
    end

    if errors.any?
      Result.new(success?: false, ticket: @ticket, comment: nil, errors: errors)
    else
      reloaded_ticket = @ticket.reload
      reloaded_comment = saved_comment&.reload

      if @mode == :staff && reloaded_comment&.public? && reloaded_ticket.email_origin?
        TicketMailer.staff_reply(ticket: reloaded_ticket, comment: reloaded_comment).deliver_now
      end

      Result.new(success?: true, ticket: reloaded_ticket, comment: reloaded_comment, errors: {})
    end
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => e
    Result.new(success?: false, ticket: @ticket, comment: nil, errors: e.record.errors.to_hash(true))
  end

  private

  def validate_and_apply_changes
    case @mode
    when :staff
      validate_and_apply_staff_changes
    when :customer
      validate_and_apply_customer_changes
    else
      raise ArgumentError, "Unknown update mode: #{@mode.inspect}"
    end
  end

  def validate_and_apply_staff_changes
    errors = {}

    unless @comment_provided || @status_provided || @priority_provided || @group_id_provided || @assignee_id_provided
      return { base: [ "Provide a comment, status, priority, group_id, or assignee_id to update" ] }
    end

    @ticket.status = @status if @status_provided
    @ticket.priority = @priority if @priority_provided

    resolved_group = nil
    group_lookup_failed = false
    if @group_id_provided && !@group_id.nil?
      parsed_group_id = parse_positive_bigint(@group_id)
      if parsed_group_id.nil?
        (errors["group_id"] ||= []) << "Group must be a valid group in this account"
        group_lookup_failed = true
      else
        resolved_group = @ticket.account.groups.find_by(id: parsed_group_id)
        if resolved_group.nil?
          (errors["group_id"] ||= []) << "Group must be a valid group in this account"
          group_lookup_failed = true
        end
      end
    end

    resolved_assignee = nil
    assignee_lookup_failed = false
    if @assignee_id_provided && !@assignee_id.nil?
      parsed_assignee_id = parse_positive_bigint(@assignee_id)
      if parsed_assignee_id.nil?
        (errors["assignee_id"] ||= []) << "Assignee must be an active staff member in this account"
        assignee_lookup_failed = true
      else
        resolved_assignee = @ticket.account.users.staff.active.find_by(id: parsed_assignee_id)
        if resolved_assignee.nil?
          (errors["assignee_id"] ||= []) << "Assignee must be an active staff member in this account"
          assignee_lookup_failed = true
        end
      end
    end

    unless group_lookup_failed || assignee_lookup_failed
      apply_group_and_assignee_changes(
        resolved_group: resolved_group,
        resolved_assignee: resolved_assignee,
        errors: errors
      )
    end

    if @comment_provided
      @pending_comment = TicketComment.new(
        account: @ticket.account,
        ticket: @ticket,
        author: @actor,
        body: @comment_body,
        public: @comment_public
      )
    end

    collect_errors(errors)
  end

  def apply_group_and_assignee_changes(resolved_group:, resolved_assignee:, errors:)
    if @group_id_provided
      if @group_id.nil?
        if @assignee_id_provided && !@assignee_id.nil?
          (errors["assignee_id"] ||= []) << "Cannot assign a user when clearing the ticket group"
          return
        end

        @ticket.group = nil
        @ticket.group_id = nil
        @ticket.assignee = nil
        @ticket.assignee_id = nil
      else
        @ticket.group = resolved_group

        if @assignee_id_provided
          if @assignee_id.nil?
            @ticket.assignee = nil
            @ticket.assignee_id = nil
          elsif member_of_group?(resolved_assignee.id, resolved_group.id)
            @ticket.assignee = resolved_assignee
          else
            (errors["assignee_id"] ||= []) << "Assignee must belong to the ticket's group"
          end
        elsif @ticket.assignee_id.present? && !member_of_group?(@ticket.assignee_id, resolved_group.id)
          @ticket.assignee = nil
          @ticket.assignee_id = nil
        end
      end
    elsif @assignee_id_provided
      if @assignee_id.nil?
        @ticket.assignee = nil
        @ticket.assignee_id = nil
      elsif @ticket.group_id.present?
        if member_of_group?(resolved_assignee.id, @ticket.group_id)
          @ticket.assignee = resolved_assignee
        else
          (errors["assignee_id"] ||= []) << "Assignee must belong to the ticket's group"
        end
      else
        default_group = resolved_assignee.default_group
        @ticket.group = default_group if default_group.present?
        @ticket.assignee = resolved_assignee
      end
    end
  end

  def member_of_group?(user_id, group_id)
    GroupMembership.exists?(
      account_id: @ticket.account_id,
      group_id: group_id,
      user_id: user_id
    )
  end

  def validate_and_apply_customer_changes
    errors = {}

    if @solved_provided && @solved != true && @solved != false
      (errors["solved"] ||= []) << "Solved must be true or false"
    end

    mark_solved_via_flag = @solved_provided && @solved == true

    unless @comment_provided || @status_provided || mark_solved_via_flag
      return errors.any? ? errors : { base: [ "Provide a comment or mark the request as solved" ] }
    end

    if @status_provided
      if @status == "solved"
        @ticket.status = "solved"
      else
        (errors["status"] ||= []) << "Customers can only mark a request as solved"
      end
    elsif mark_solved_via_flag
      @ticket.status = "solved"
    elsif @comment_provided && (@ticket.pending? || @ticket.solved?)
      @ticket.status = "open"
    end

    if @comment_provided
      @pending_comment = TicketComment.new(
        account: @ticket.account,
        ticket: @ticket,
        author: @actor,
        body: @comment_body,
        public: true
      )
    end

    collect_errors(errors)
  end

  def parse_positive_bigint(raw)
    value = case raw
            when Integer
              raw
            when String
              return nil unless /\A[1-9]\d*\z/.match?(raw)
              Integer(raw, 10)
            else
              return nil
            end
    return nil unless value.positive? && value <= MAX_BIGINT

    value
  end

  def collect_errors(errors = {})
    unless @ticket.valid?
      @ticket.errors.each do |error|
        next if error.attribute == :status && errors["status"].present?
        next if error.attribute == :group_id && errors["group_id"].present?
        next if error.attribute == :assignee_id && errors["assignee_id"].present?

        (errors[error.attribute.to_s] ||= []) << error.full_message
      end
    end

    if @pending_comment && !@pending_comment.valid?
      @pending_comment.errors.each do |error|
        (errors["comment.#{error.attribute}"] ||= []) << error.full_message
      end
    end

    errors
  end
end
EOF

class UserUpdater
  Result = Struct.new(:success?, :user, :errors, keyword_init: true)

  def initialize(
    account:,
    user:,
    name_provided: false,
    name: nil,
    role_provided: false,
    role: nil,
    suspended_provided: false,
    suspended: nil
  )
    @account = account
    @user = user
    @name_provided = name_provided
    @name = name
    @role_provided = role_provided
    @role = role
    @suspended_provided = suspended_provided
    @suspended = suspended
  end

  def call
    errors = {}

    ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
      @account.lock!
      @user.lock!
      now = Time.current

      unless @name_provided || @role_provided || @suspended_provided
        errors["base"] = [ "Provide suspended, name, or role to update" ]
        raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
      end

      if @suspended_provided && @suspended != true && @suspended != false
        (errors["suspended"] ||= []) << "Suspended must be true or false"
      end

      was_active_admin = @user.admin? && @user.active?
      target_suspended = if @suspended_provided && (@suspended == true || @suspended == false)
                           @suspended
                         else
                           @user.suspended?
                         end
      target_role = @role_provided ? @role : @user.role

      if was_active_admin
        other_active_admins = @account.users.admins.active.where.not(id: @user.id).exists?
        if !other_active_admins
          if target_suspended
            (errors["suspended"] ||= []) << "Cannot suspend the last active admin"
          elsif @role_provided && User::ROLES.include?(target_role) && target_role != "admin"
            (errors["role"] ||= []) << "Cannot demote the last active admin"
          end
        end
      end

      @user.name = @name if @name_provided
      @user.role = @role if @role_provided
      if @suspended_provided && (@suspended == true || @suspended == false)
        @user.suspended_at = @suspended ? (@user.suspended_at || now) : nil
      end

      unless @user.valid?
        @user.errors.each do |error|
          next if error.attribute == :role && errors["role"].present?
          next if error.attribute == :suspended && errors["suspended"].present?

          (errors[error.attribute.to_s] ||= []) << error.full_message
        end
      end

      if errors.any?
        raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
      end

      @user.save! if @user.changed?

      if @user.suspended?
        @user.revoke_all_sessions!
        @user.clear_ticket_assignments!(now: now)
        @user.revoke_tokens!(purpose: UserToken::PASSWORD_RESET)
      end

      if @role_provided && !@user.staff?
        @user.clear_ticket_assignments!(now: now) unless @user.suspended?
        @user.group_memberships.delete_all
      end
    end

    if errors.any?
      Result.new(success?: false, user: @user, errors: errors)
    else
      Result.new(success?: true, user: @user.reload, errors: {})
    end
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => e
    Result.new(success?: false, user: @user, errors: e.record.errors.to_hash(true))
  end
end

module Api
  module V1
    class TicketsController < BaseController
      before_action :require_authentication!
      before_action :require_active_account!
      before_action :require_staff!

      def index
        base_scope = current_account.tickets.recently_active.includes(:requester, :group, :assignee)
        result = TicketFilter.new(scope: base_scope, params: params, mode: :staff).call
        return render_validation_errors(result.errors) unless result.success?

        payload = paginate_collection(result.scope, key: :tickets) { |ticket| serialize_ticket(ticket) }
        render json: payload, status: :ok
      end

      def show
        ticket = find_ticket!
        render json: { ticket: serialize_ticket(ticket) }, status: :ok
      end

      def update
        ticket = find_ticket!
        ticket_envelope = require_hash_param(:ticket)
        comment_envelope = optional_hash_param(:comment, ticket_envelope)

        status_provided = ticket_envelope.key?(:status)
        status_value = status_provided ? ticket_envelope.permit(:status)[:status] : nil

        priority_provided = ticket_envelope.key?(:priority)
        priority_value = priority_provided ? ticket_envelope.permit(:priority)[:priority] : nil

        group_id_provided = ticket_envelope.key?(:group_id)
        group_id_value = group_id_provided ? ticket_envelope[:group_id] : nil

        assignee_id_provided = ticket_envelope.key?(:assignee_id)
        assignee_id_value = assignee_id_provided ? ticket_envelope[:assignee_id] : nil

        comment_public = true
        if comment_envelope&.key?(:public)
          raw_public = comment_envelope[:public]
          comment_public = (raw_public == true || raw_public == false) ? raw_public : nil
        end

        result = TicketUpdater.new(
          ticket: ticket,
          actor: current_user,
          mode: :staff,
          comment_provided: !comment_envelope.nil?,
          comment_body: comment_envelope ? comment_envelope.permit(:body)[:body] : nil,
          comment_public: comment_public,
          status_provided: status_provided,
          status: status_value,
          priority_provided: priority_provided,
          priority: priority_value,
          group_id_provided: group_id_provided,
          group_id: group_id_value,
          assignee_id_provided: assignee_id_provided,
          assignee_id: assignee_id_value

cat <<'EOF' > /app/app/controllers/api/v1/group_memberships_controller.rb
module Api
  module V1
    class GroupMembershipsController < BaseController
      MAX_BIGINT = (1 << 63) - 1
      POSITIVE_INTEGER_FORMAT = /\A[1-9]\d*\z/

      before_action :require_authentication!
      before_action :require_active_account!
      before_action :require_staff!, only: %i[index show]
      before_action :require_admin!, only: %i[create destroy make_default]

      def index
        scope = current_account.group_memberships.includes(:group, :user).by_id_asc
        errors = {}

        if params[:group_id].present?
          group_id = parse_filter_bigint(params[:group_id])
          if group_id
            scope = scope.for_group(group_id)
          else
            errors["group_id"] = [ "Group must be a valid group ID" ]
          end
        end

        if params[:user_id].present?
          user_id = parse_filter_bigint(params[:user_id])
          if user_id
            scope = scope.for_user(user_id)
          else
            errors["user_id"] = [ "User must be a valid user ID" ]
          end
        end

        return render_validation_errors(errors) if errors.any?

        payload = paginate_collection(scope, key: :group_memberships) do |membership|
          serialize_group_membership(membership)
        end
        render json: payload, status: :ok
      end

      def show
        membership = find_membership!
        render json: { group_membership: serialize_group_membership(membership) }, status: :ok
      end

      def create
        membership_envelope = require_hash_param(:group_membership)

        default_provided = membership_envelope.key?(:default)
        default_value = default_provided ? membership_envelope[:default] : nil

        result = GroupMembershipCreation.new(
          account: current_account,
          group_id: membership_envelope[:group_id],
          user_id: membership_envelope[:user_id],
          default_provided: default_provided,
          default: default_value
        ).call

        if result.success?
          render json: { group_membership: serialize_group_membership(result.group_membership) }, status: :created
        else
          render_validation_errors(result.errors)
        end
      end

      def destroy
        membership = find_membership!
        GroupMembershipDeletion.new(account: current_account, membership: membership).call
        head :no_content
      end

      def make_default
        membership = find_membership!
        updated = GroupMembershipMakeDefault.new(account: current_account, membership: membership).call
        render json: { group_membership: serialize_group_membership(updated) }, status: :ok
      end

      private

      def find_membership!
        current_account.group_memberships.includes(:group, :user).find(parse_id_param(:id))
      end

      def parse_filter_bigint(raw)
        return nil unless raw.is_a?(String)

        value = raw.strip
        return nil unless POSITIVE_INTEGER_FORMAT.match?(value)

        parsed = Integer(value, 10)
        parsed <= MAX_BIGINT ? parsed : nil
      rescue ArgumentError
        nil
      end
    end
  end
end
EOF

class GroupAndMembershipIntegrityTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  setup do
    @acme = Account.create!(name: "Acme", subdomain: "acme")
    @globex = Account.create!(name: "Globex", subdomain: "globex")

    @acme_admin = @acme.users.create!(
      name: "Jo",
      email: "jo@acme.test",
      password: "jo-password-1",
      role: "admin",
      verified_at: Time.current
    )
    @acme_agent = @acme.users.create!(
      name: "Sam",
      email: "sam@acme.test",
      password: "sam-password-1",
      role: "agent",
      verified_at: Time.current
    )
    @acme_customer = @acme.users.create!(
      name: "Avery",
      email: "avery@example.test",
      password: "avery-password-1",
      role: "customer",
      verified_at: Time.current
    )
    @globex_admin = @globex.users.create!(
      name: "Pat",
      email: "pat@globex.test",
      password: "pat-password-1",
      role: "admin",
      verified_at: Time.current
    )
  end

  test "group validates name normalization, length, and per-account case-insensitive uniqueness" do
    billing = @acme.groups.create!(name: "  Billing  ")
    assert_equal "Billing", billing.name

    duplicate = @acme.groups.build(name: "billing")
    assert_not duplicate.valid?
    assert duplicate.errors[:name].any?

    # Same name in another account is valid
    globex_billing = @globex.groups.create!(name: "Billing")
    assert_equal "Billing", globex_billing.name

    # Blank and over-length names are invalid
    [ nil, "", "   ", "a" * 256 ].each do |bad_name|
      g = @acme.groups.build(name: bad_name)
      assert_not g.valid?, "Expected name=#{bad_name.inspect} to be invalid"
      assert g.errors[:name].any?
    end
  end

  test "group membership enforces account integrity, staff-only users, uniqueness, and single default per user" do
    acme_billing = @acme.groups.create!(name: "Billing")
    acme_support = @acme.groups.create!(name: "Technical Support")
    globex_billing = @globex.groups.create!(name: "Billing")

    # Rejects customer
    customer_membership = @acme.group_memberships.build(group: acme_billing, user: @acme_customer, default: true)
    assert_not customer_membership.valid?
    assert_includes customer_membership.errors[:user], "must be a staff member"

    # Rejects cross-account user
    cross_user = @acme.group_memberships.build(group: acme_billing, user: @globex_admin, default: true)
    assert_not cross_user.valid?
    assert_includes cross_user.errors[:user], "must belong to the same account"

    # Rejects cross-account group
    cross_group = @acme.group_memberships.build(group: globex_billing, user: @acme_agent, default: true)
    assert_not cross_group.valid?
    assert_includes cross_group.errors[:group], "must belong to the same account"

    # Valid membership for staff (including suspended staff)
    @acme_agent.update!(suspended_at: Time.current)
    m1 = @acme.group_memberships.create!(group: acme_billing, user: @acme_agent, default: true)
    assert m1.persisted?

    # Rejects duplicate (group, user)
    dup = @acme.group_memberships.build(group: acme_billing, user: @acme_agent, default: false)
    assert_not dup.valid?
    assert dup.errors[:user_id].any?

    # Partial unique index prevents two default memberships for the same user at DB level
    assert_raises ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique do
      @acme.group_memberships.create!(group: acme_support, user: @acme_agent, default: true)
    end
  end

  test "ticket validates same-account group and assignee belongs to ticket group" do
    acme_billing = @acme.groups.create!(name: "Billing")
    globex_billing = @globex.groups.create!(name: "Billing")
    ticket = @acme.tickets.create!(requester: @acme_customer, subject: "Help")

    # Cross-account group rejected
    ticket.group = globex_billing
    assert_not ticket.valid?
    assert_includes ticket.errors[:group_id], "must belong to the same account"

    # Assignee not in ticket's group rejected
    ticket.group = acme_billing
    ticket.assignee = @acme_agent
    assert_not ticket.valid?
    assert_includes ticket.errors[:assignee_id], "must belong to the ticket's group"

    # Once agent joins group, valid!
    @acme.group_memberships.create!(group: acme_billing, user: @acme_agent, default: true)
    assert ticket.valid?
    ticket.save!

    # Ungrouped ticket with assignee still valid
    ungrouped = @acme.tickets.build(requester: @acme_customer, subject: "No group", group: nil, assignee: @acme_admin)
    assert ungrouped.valid?
  end

  test "purging a cancelled account removes its groups and group memberships" do
    billing = @acme.groups.create!(name: "Billing")
    membership = @acme.group_memberships.create!(group: billing, user: @acme_agent, default: true)
    @acme.tickets.create!(requester: @acme_customer, subject: "Help", group: billing, assignee: @acme_agent)

    globex_group = @globex.groups.create!(name: "Billing")
    globex_membership = @globex.group_memberships.create!(group: globex_group, user: @globex_admin, default: true)

    @acme.update_column(:cancelled_at, 91.days.ago)
    assert_equal 1, Account.purge_cancelled!

    assert_not Group.exists?(billing.id)
    assert_not GroupMembership.exists?(membership.id)
    assert Group.exists?(globex_group.id)
    assert GroupMembership.exists?(globex_membership.id)
  end
end
EOF

    )

    assert_equal @agent_id, sam_billing["user_id"]

    # Second membership for Sam without default -> default: false, first stays default: true

    assert_equal false, sam_support["default"]

    get "/api/v1/group_memberships/#{sam_billing['id']}", headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @agent_token)
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal true, json_body.dig("group_membership", "default")

    # Third membership for Sam with default: true -> becomes default, demotes previous default
    sam_escalations = create_membership!(group_id: escalations["id"], user_id: @agent_id, default: true)
    assert_equal true, sam_escalations["default"]

    get "/api/v1/group_memberships?user_id=#{@agent_id}", headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @agent_token)
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal [ sam_billing["id"], sam_support["id"], sam_escalations["id"] ],
                 json_body["group_memberships"].map { |m| m["id"] }
    assert_equal [ false, false, true ],
                 json_body["group_memberships"].map { |m| m["default"] }

    # Duplicate membership with default: true fails 422 without changing existing default
    post "/api/v1/group_memberships",
         params: { group_membership: { group_id: billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id, default: true } },
         headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token),
         as: :json
    assert_response :unprocessable_content

    get "/api/v1/group_memberships/#{sam_escalations['id']}", headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token)
    assert_equal true, json_body.dig("group_membership", "default")

    # Add Jo (owner/admin) to Billing (first -> default) and Support
    jo_billing = create_membership!(group_id: billing["id"], user_id: @owner_id)
    assert_equal true, jo_billing["default"]
    jo_support = create_membership!(group_id: support["id"], user_id: @owner_id, default: false)
    assert_equal false, jo_support["default"]

    # List all ordered by ID ascending
    get "/api/v1/group_memberships", headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @agent_token)
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal 5, json_body["count"]
    assert_equal [ sam_billing["id"], sam_support["id"], sam_escalations["id"], jo_billing["id"], jo_support["id"] ],
                 json_body["group_memberships"].map { |m| m["id"] }

    # Filter by group_id
    get "/api/v1/group_memberships?group_id=#{billing['id']}", headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @agent_token)
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal [ sam_billing["id"], jo_billing["id"] ], json_body["group_memberships"].map { |m| m["id"] }

    # Filter by user_id
    get "/api/v1/group_memberships?user_id=#{@owner_id}", headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @agent_token)
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal [ jo_billing["id"], jo_support["id"] ], json_body["group_memberships"].map { |m| m["id"] }

    # Filter by both group_id and user_id
    get "/api/v1/group_memberships?group_id=#{support['id']}&user_id=#{@owner_id}", headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @agent_token)
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal [ jo_support["id"] ], json_body["group_memberships"].map { |m| m["id"] }

    # make_default switches Sam's default to sam_support
    put "/api/v1/group_memberships/#{sam_support['id']}/make_default",
        headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token)
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal true, json_body.dig("group_membership", "default")

    # Idempotent make_default on already-default membership
    put "/api/v1/group_memberships/#{sam_support['id']}/make_default",
        headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token)
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal true, json_body.dig("group_membership", "default")

    get "/api/v1/group_memberships?user_id=#{@agent_id}", headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token)
    assert_equal [ false, true, false ], json_body["group_memberships"].map { |m| m["default"] }

    # Deleting Sam's default (sam_support) picks another remaining membership (sam_billing)
    delete "/api/v1/group_memberships/#{sam_support['id']}", headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token)
    assert_response :no_content

    get "/api/v1/group_memberships?user_id=#{@agent_id}", headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token)
    assert_equal [ sam_billing["id"], sam_escalations["id"] ], json_body["group_memberships"].map { |m| m["id"] }
    assert_equal [ true, false ], json_body["group_memberships"].map { |m| m["default"] }

    # Deleting non-default membership (sam_escalations) keeps sam_billing as default
    delete "/api/v1/group_memberships/#{sam_escalations['id']}", headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token)
    assert_response :no_content

    get "/api/v1/group_memberships?user_id=#{@agent_id}", headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token)
    assert_equal [ sam_billing["id"] ], json_body["group_memberships"].map { |m| m["id"] }
    assert_equal [ true ], json_body["group_memberships"].map { |m| m["default"] }

    # Deleting last remaining membership leaves Sam with 0 memberships
    delete "/api/v1/group_memberships/#{sam_billing['id']}", headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token)
    assert_response :no_content

    get "/api/v1/group_memberships?user_id=#{@agent_id}", headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token)
    assert_equal [], json_body["group_memberships"]
    assert_equal 0, json_body["count"]

    # Deleting a group promotes replacement default for users whose default was that group!
    # Jo has jo_billing (default: true) and jo_support (default: false)
    # Add Alex to billing ONLY (default: true)
    alex_billing = create_membership!(group_id: billing["id"], user_id: @admin2_id)
    assert_equal true, alex_billing["default"]

    delete "/api/v1/groups/#{billing['id']}", headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token)
    assert_response :no_content

    # Jo's remaining membership (jo_support) is automatically promoted to default: true!
    get "/api/v1/group_memberships?user_id=#{@owner_id}", headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token)
    assert_equal [ jo_support["id"] ], json_body["group_memberships"].map { |m| m["id"] }
    assert_equal [ true ], json_body["group_memberships"].map { |m| m["default"] }

    # Alex has 0 remaining memberships
    get "/api/v1/group_memberships?user_id=#{@admin2_id}", headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token)
    assert_equal [], json_body["group_memberships"]
  end

         headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token),
         as: :json
    assert_response :unprocessable_content

    # Malformed default values -> 422
    [ "true", "false", 1, 0, nil, "yes", [] ].each do |bad_default|
      post "/api/v1/group_memberships",
           params: { group_membership: { group_id: acme_group["id"], user_id: @owner_id, default: bad_default } },
           headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token),
           as: :json
      assert_response :unprocessable_content, "Expected 422 for default=#{bad_default.inspect}"
    end

    # Malformed group_id / user_id -> 422
    [ 0, -1, "", "abc", true, false, [ acme_group["id"] ], { id: acme_group["id"] }, 999_999 ].each do |bad_id|
      post "/api/v1/group_memberships",
           params: { group_membership: { group_id: bad_id, user_id: @owner_id } },

           as: :json
      assert_response :unprocessable_content, "Expected 422 for user_id=#{bad_id.inspect}"
    end

    # Cancelled account blocks group/membership endpoints (403)
    post "/api/v1/account/cancel", headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token)
    assert_response :ok
    reactivate_token = sign_in!(subdomain: "acme", email: "jo@acme.test", password: "my-first-password").dig("session", "token")
    get "/api/v1/groups", headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: reactivate_token)

    get "/api/v1/group_memberships", headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: reactivate_token)
